name: Companies House API
tagline: UK company registry data — search, profiles, filings, and officers via the official government API
description: Official UK government API for Companies House public company information. Search companies by name or number, retrieve company profiles, filing history, officers, persons with significant control (PSC), registered office addresses, and insolvency data. Used by developers building KYC, compliance, business intelligence, and due-diligence tools against the live UK company register.

auth.details: HTTP Basic Auth: API key as username, blank password (or key in Authorization header as Basic base64(key:)). Free self-serve signup at the developer hub.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free public data API with rate limits; no per-request charge for standard public data endpoints
pricing.paid_plans: Streaming API and some bulk/product offerings may be paid; check developer hub for current product pricing

rate_limits: 600 requests per 5 minutes per API key (public data API); check developer hub for product-specific limits
use_cases: look up a UK company by company number
search companies by name for KYC or onboarding
list officers and directors for a company
fetch filing history or latest accounts metadata
get persons with significant control (PSC) for compliance checks
